definition: Nationalistic means marked by aggressive devotion to one's own nation — pride swollen into a claim of superiority over all the others.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word nationalistic. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know nationalistic should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Critics called the new stamp series nationalistic: every design showed the country's inventions towering over smaller, blurrier versions of everyone else's.
Patriotic is milder than nationalistic — real love of country that needs no ranking and picks no fight with anyone else's.
Jingoistic goes further than nationalistic: the superiority turns belligerent, itching for confrontation abroad to prove the point.

Chauvinistic is the wider disease — aggressive, blind conviction that your own group, whatever it is, outranks the rest. Nationalistic is chauvinism with a flag on it: the group is the nation, and the ranking is the point.

Flag-waving is the show — anthems cranked up, banners on every porch, loyalty performed loudly for the crowd. Nationalistic goes deeper than display: it is the settled belief that the nation deserves the top spot, whether or not anyone is watching.
